Does the order refer strictly to the positions i < j < k, or also to the characters appearing in that order regardless of other intervening characters?
Should the count be of distinct triples (i, j, k), or is it the number of places (positions) where such a triple ends/occurs?
If S contains characters other than A, B, C, are they ignored, or must the triples only involve those specific characters?
